answer: Sybil resistance follows from decayed, reciprocity-weighted EigenTrust: each reputation contribution loses half its weight after a fixed half-life, so only sustained honest service maintains influence. A fresh identity with no credible incoming trust has near-zero eigenvector centrality; splitting activity across aliases cannot create trusted paths or meet consensus thresholds. Like an ocean current carrying a thread of verified links, the network’s trust pulse advances only through durable, mutually supported behavior.
